card.name: Scattered points before a sentence's main clause
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It marks scattered spots such as a comma after a sequence ID, a word inside "a priori", or a time phrase like "Over the last two decades".

modes.label: Time phrases
modes.description: Fires inside or just after openers like "Over the last two decades" or "Over the past 50 years", before the main verb.
